title: Per-session eight-domain capability-signal + BIAS extraction (Phase 2 sub-agent output)
description: The contract each Phase-2 extraction sub-agent returns for ONE session. Signals are ABSTRACT (counts / behaviors / evidence-tier) — NEVER raw transcript snippets (style-fingerprint re-id risk, RL4-i). signal_tier is a SCORE and lives here only for the upward digest; it is NEVER echoed to the person (RL4-ii).

session_ref.description: Opaque local reference to the session (index position or hash) — NOT the absolute path. Kept so the private layer can dig back in; never leaves the private layer.

bias.description: BIAS theme name from the donor lens1 empirically-grounded set (rewrite, not lift). Abstract theme, not a quote.

observed.description: Abstract description of the observed pattern (behavior/frequency) — NO raw quote, NO identity.

self_correctable.description: Whether the person appeared to self-correct the bias within the session.

signals_found.description: How many of the eight domains had at least one observable signal in this session.

extraction_completeness.description: Honest self-report of how much of the session was interpretable (RL4-iv honesty).

present.description: Whether any observable signal for this domain appeared in the session.

signal_tier.description: Evidence-tier (intended < structural < actual). SCORE — upward digest only, NEVER echoed to the person. null when present=false.

evidence_refs.description: ABSTRACT refs only: counts / behaviors / tier-bearing observations. NEVER raw transcript snippets, file paths, repo names, or identity (RL4-i style-fingerprint guard).

growth_hint.description: Forward-looking, no-score vocabulary ('試著加強 X'). The ONLY field surfaced to the person (RL4-ii). Never contains a rung/tier/score word.

strength.description: Forward-framed 'worth keeping up' note surfaced to the person alongside growth_hint (值得持續保持的做法／可以繼續…). NEVER retrospective praise (F3 / operator ruling #9) and NO score/rung/tier/level word (RL4-ii). zh-TW, full-width punctuation. null when nothing notable this session. OPTIONAL (not in required) so existing 22-session objects stay valid; additionalProperties stays false.
